title: PC3 menus can get cut off or drawn under standard windows because they aren't drawn as a separate window
line: The context menu of a text field on the desktop, like the file rename field, now appears above other windows instead of underneath them.
explanation: The right-click menu of text fields (qqc2-desktop-style's shared TextFieldContextMenu, used by the desktop's rename field) was an in-scene popup, drawn inside the text field's own window. On the desktop that window sits below every app window, so the menu was covered by them or cut off at the window's edge. The menu now opens as a window popup (popupType Window) from a 1x1 point at the click or text cursor, because on Wayland a window menu is placed against its whole parent item. Inside a QQuickWidget (System Settings sidebar and KCMs) it stays in-scene, since there the right-button release went to the menu window and the field's TapHandler then ignored the next right-click.

commits.message:
TextFieldContextMenu: Open the menu as its own window

The text menu was drawn inside the field's window, so in Plasma it was
cut off or covered by other windows. Now it opens as a window popup at
the click, except in a QQuickWidget, where it missed the next click.

BUG: 517982

media.caption: Desktop rename field (F2) right-clicked with Konsole next to the icon: the text menu is drawn underneath Konsole, only its left strip visible
Same steps with the fix: the text menu opens at the pointer above Konsole

review.text: Opening the text field menu as a window popup from a 1x1 anchor fixes the desktop rename field, but it changes the text menu in every QQC2 app with the org.kde.desktop style. Nate recalls window popups being buggy there. The QQuickWidget exception depends on Qt's internal offscreen-window objectName, which is fragile and hides a Qt bug instead of reporting it.
changes: Replace the objectName "QQuickWidgetOffscreenWindow" check with something that doesn't rely on Qt internals, and report the missed-release problem in QQuickWidget to Qt (link it in a comment)

Check with the qqc2-desktop-style maintainers that switching every app's text menu to Window popups is wanted, and test it in a couple of real apps (e.g. Dolphin location bar, Kate search field, a Kirigami app) on Wayland before submitting
